The super-admin’s shell

The navigation of an account that administers only, and how it says whose session it is. Brief #532 and its amendments; code #533.

T1 · The panel: the band, «Адміністрування», the footer

The band in the capital’s slot. A user sees the capital in this strip; the super-admin has none, so the strip says the role: lucide Shield (18, sb-icon-active) and «Суперадміністратор» (14 px font-display, 600, ink) on sb-field, the collapse chevron where it always is. Words and a glyph on a band, so not colour alone (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1, 1.3.1), and more than one signal (NN/g, Modes: “at least two visual indicators”). At 15 px the word truncates in the band; at 14 it fits.

The nav. «Адміністрування» holds «Архів цін» (lucide Archive), in the nav’s pill. «Стан» will be a second group under a divider once its first page exists. No «Ввід», «Аналітика» or capital. The footer: the theme track alone at full width (currency moves only portfolio figures), Settings, the account, the links, the version.

T2 · The rail, the header bar, the drawer

The rail folds the band: a full-bleed strip 40 high under the burger, the shield centred, ending at the wall’s edge as the panel’s band does. The rail has no room for the word: a screen reader reads it as the strip’s text, and a pointer resting on the strip shows it as the rail items’ tooltips show theirs. «Архів цін» is the rail’s one item; no currency box. Beside the collapsed rail a header stands, as it does for a user, carrying the role where a user sees the capital. Below md the header bar does the same: the shield in accent and «Суперадміністратор» (15 px font-display), on the page plane, the header refusing the sb-* family. The drawer covers the header bar, so it draws the panel’s band itself, without the chevron.

T3 · /settings

The header with «Тема й мова» for its subtitle, and Appearance with theme and language. No Data and no Automation card (they read the portfolio’s routes), no currency row, no «Адміністрування» card.

T4 · While GET /me is out, and after it fails

Out: the role is unknown, so nothing that depends on it is drawn. The band’s slot is held as its empty box (a user’s capital and the super-admin’s band share it, so nothing moves when the answer lands); the nav band is empty; the footer’s theme row is held invisible at its height; Settings, the account, the links and the version stand; below md the header bar shows its trigger alone. No indicator, so no other role sees one arrive or leave. The collapsed rail holds a user’s foot: the currency box’s place is kept, invisible, so a user’s rail never moves; the super-admin’s foot drops 38 px when the answer lands, as its band and nav arrive (amendment 6). Beside it the header bar stands empty at its height, for every role, and its content arrives with the answer. Failed: the shell as while out, and the page is the app’s failed-screen state on every route.

T5 · Measured

Contrast of the indicator, read on the running app with the text composited over its real background (SC 1.4.3 asks 4,5 for this size), and of the shield beside it. Only what is drawn and visible is listed: the rail draws the shield alone, its word being read as the strip’s text by a screen reader.

T7 · Refused, and not drawn

  • A gear beside the mark: the gear is Settings here and in Lucide, Material and Octicons.
  • Colour alone, a border or a tint with no words (SC 1.4.1).
  • A chip beside the wordmark: mark, wordmark, chip and chevron need 242 px of the row’s 211.
  • The role in the account row (step 1, B): it stands at the panel’s foot, out of the eye’s path at its top, and the rail and the header bar have no address row to carry it.
  • The wall’s edge in sb-indicator with a text chip (step 1, D): the edge repeats the colour that already marks the current route, and no edge reaches the header bar below md.
  • A rail tile (step 2): it takes the box every rail item uses, so it reads as one more pressable item. «СА» letters: an abbreviation nothing else in the app uses.
  • The capital’s caption recipe in the header bar, «Ви увійшли як» over the role: a new phrase for what the role already says. A chip at the bar’s end: it leaves the capital’s place empty and reads as a status badge (step 2).
  • No header beside the collapsed rail: the rail draws the shield alone, so the word would leave the screen. A drawer without the band: the drawer covers the header bar, so no indicator would show while it is open (step 2).
  • Skeleton rows while /me is out: they would misstate one role’s count (10 items or 1). A blank band slot: the band would arrive with the answer, where the held box moves nothing. A second failure line in the nav: it states the failed-screen state’s failure twice, in a new phrase (step 3).
  • Any change to the mark, and currency anywhere in the super-admin’s shell.
  • The pages of #541 and #542, and «Стан»: not drawn here.
